html:
As a part of its ongoing research and development work Envisys has recently developed an automated system for complete isopropanol based chemical cleaning of medical devices/equipment. An innovative and cost-effective cleaning solution for sensitive medical devices of varied dimensions and shapes. The system comes with phenomenal benefits as a substitute to existing tedious manual process persued in the said industry.
